name: ConnectedComponents
label: Connected Components
description: Label the connected components of the foreground: every group of touching non-background voxels gets its own label, numbered by size so the largest component has the highest label. Components smaller than the minimum size are dropped.

parameters.name: background_value
parameters.label: Background Value
parameters.description: Voxels with this value are background; every other value is foreground.

parameters.name: connectivity
parameters.label: Connectivity
parameters.description: Which neighbouring voxels count as connected.

parameters.name: min_size
parameters.label: Minimum Size (voxels)
parameters.description: Components with fewer voxels than this are returned to the background.
